expenses.label: Annual spending
expenses.description: Recorded expenditures during the selected reporting year. Nominal dollars.

property_tax_extraction.label: Annual tax extraction
property_tax_extraction.description: Recorded property-tax increment for the selected reporting year. Nominal dollars.

fund_balance_end.label: Ending fund balance
fund_balance_end.description: Recorded balance at year-end. It does not establish uncommitted funds.

cumulative_property_tax_extraction.label: Cumulative tax extraction
cumulative_property_tax_extraction.description: Recorded tax extraction accumulated through the selected year, including earlier years. Do not sum it across years.
